titles.en: The Blue Fairy and the Field of Wonders

continuity.opening: The blue-haired Fairy sends a Falcon to rescue Pinocchio from the oak.
continuity.closing: Pinocchio leaves prison free but still aware that he has not mastered the lesson behind his repeated choices.
continuity.next: On the road back, Pinocchio will face further injustice and discover that Geppetto has vanished while searching for him.

learningObjective: Explain how fear, lying, and wishful thinking reinforce one another through clear cause-and-effect language.

beats.title: The Fairy's Rescue
beats.purpose: Move from danger into magical care and a sharply comic diagnosis.

beats.title: The Bitter Medicine
beats.purpose: Contrast imagined fear with the manageable truth.

beats.title: A Nose Full of Lies
beats.purpose: Make each lie create a visible and escalating consequence.

beats.title: The Straight Road
beats.purpose: Restore Pinocchio and give him one simple instruction.

beats.title: The Same Sweet Promise
beats.purpose: Show Pinocchio recognising the swindlers yet choosing their story again.

beats.title: Four Coins in the Earth
beats.purpose: Stage the ritual of the trick and the long, empty wait.

beats.title: The Parrot's Truth
beats.purpose: Replace the imagined fortune with an unmistakable explanation.

beats.title: Justice Turned Upside Down
beats.purpose: Expose Simpleton Town's logic and end with freedom that solves no deeper problem.
